en.io: Inputs raw text prompts or design system specifications, and outputs categorized prompt elements, reusability scores, database entries, and a markdown learning report.
en.boundary: It strictly handles the analysis, extraction, and database management of prompt elements, without directly generating or rendering final images and videos.
scenarios: Extracting materials and lighting techniques from a single image generation prompt
Batch parsing multiple prompts to automatically populate a local element database
Analyzing full design systems or workflow specifications to save structured visual reference templates

zh.io: 输入提示词文本或设计系统规范，输出分类后的可复用元素、复用性评分、数据库更新记录及学习报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责 Prompt 元素的提取、打标签与数据库归档，不负责直接生成或渲染图像与视频。
scenarios: 从单个图像提示词中提取材质、构图和拍摄视角等复用组件
批量解析多个提示词或配置文件以更新本地元素库
解析并保存完整的设计系统规范与工作流模板
